definitions.explanation: Training that involves actual practice in the field, as opposed to theoretical study.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧で{実習|じっしゅう}をする。
examples.english: I do practical training at a hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧{実習|じっしゅう}で⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to an elementary school for teaching practice.

examples.japanese: {実習|じっしゅう}を⟦{通|とお}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多く：18752_ooku⟧のことを⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I learned a lot through practical training.

notes:
{実習|じっしゅう} combines {実|じつ} (actual/real) + {習|しゅう} (learning).

TYPES:
- ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧{実習|じっしゅう} (teaching practice)
- ⟦{看護|かんご}→看護：13668_kango⟧{実習|じっしゅう} (nursing practice)
- ⟦{臨床|りんしょう}→臨床：13975_rinshou⟧{実習|じっしゅう} (clinical practice)
- ⟦{技能|ぎのう}→技能：12801_ginou⟧{実習|じっしゅう} (technical training)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {実習|じっしゅう}をする/を{行|おこな}う (to do practical training)
- {実習|じっしゅう}{生|せい} (trainee, intern)
- {実習|じっしゅう}{先|さき} (place of internship)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {実習|じっしゅう}: practical training (academic/professional)
- インターンシップ: internship (from English)
- ⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧: training (professional development)
